article_title: 数据复制的三条路：单主、多主与无主

reader_takeaway: 读者能区分单主、多主和无主复制的写入路径，并根据一致性、延迟与故障目标选择最简单的方案

final_prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese technology blog article, aspect ratio 2.35:1. Primary request: create a clear conceptual cover comparing three data replication strategies in distributed systems. Theme: replication improves availability but changes where coordination, conflicts, and repair happen. Summary angle: one luminous data capsule travels through three connected routes that show single-leader, multi-leader, and leaderless replication. Narrative flow: 3-beat comparison. Information blocks: first, one prominent leader tower broadcasts the capsule to two smaller follower towers, with the approved label exactly '单主'; second, two equal leader towers launch versions toward one central merge point, with the approved label exactly '多主'; third, three equal replica nodes receive the capsule and exactly two light up as acknowledgements, with the approved label exactly '无主'. Main metaphor: a lively data transit network where the same capsule follows three coordination patterns. Primary subject: one luminous data capsule that visually connects the entire frame. Composition: ultra-wide horizontal flow, three connected zones without separate comic panels, capsule remains the dominant focal point, bold readable arrows, generous negative space, clear at thumbnail size. Style/medium: combine abstract technical concept art with American cartoon illustration, elastic shapes, clear expressions suggested through tower forms, bold color fields, light comedic timing. Use deep navy, warm white, bright orange, and teal-green accents. Visible text policy: render only '单主', '多主', and '无主'; no title, sentences, English words, formulas, numbers, extra labels, fake UI, watermark, or prompt residue. Constraints: exactly one dominant luminous capsule, three supporting comparison beats, simple node counts, no product logos, no screenshots, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage. Avoid generic robots, code rain, neon city backgrounds, giant HUD overlays, dense equations, excessive characters, complex multi-panel comics, decorative clutter, and illegible microtext.
